status.detail: Historical review cap reached: seven automated reviews, with latest Lite/incomplete and no current-head cloud coverage. Audited the main merge and ten-file Light Switch/Settings GA migration at the new head; no defensible independent finding retained. The 17 final Settings CLI probes cover help/version, missing module arguments (including after --), unknown commands and list invalid-input errors. They do not cover successful enable/disable actions, settings persistence, corrupt files, locking, GPO or telemetry assertions.

Prior 63 ImageResizer parser and 130 PowerDisplay test passes belong exclusively to head 279331c7cd56516eb1c67453f64a36d4bec4d9d5; they are not current-head build/test evidence and were not transferred.

DSC, Awake, FancyZones, ImageResizer, PowerDisplay and Command Palette consumer builds/tests were not repeated on this head. Retained migration C# sources were compared exactly, but inherited dependencies/project context can still affect them.
No local ARM64/Release/AOT, live service or UI validation, packaging, signing, trust or deployment check.

Seven historical automated reviews already exceed the five-round cap. The latest reports Lite and a full-agentic startup timeout, and none covers the current head. No new routine review request was made; this is not approval or full cloud convergence.

delta_audit.detail: Old-to-current history is a main merge (442 inherited changed paths), then ten new author migration paths. All original changed C# blobs are byte-identical to the old reviewed head. Four original non-C# blobs changed through inherited main context; they were separately reconciled. No retained review-only fix or experiment is exported as an upstream finding.
